summary.headline: Speaking review of t2assaf (la / min) and 5ereb / 5arrab, then a quick quiz on earlier verb pairs

rules.title: t2assaf la / t2assaf min = apologize to someone (both work the same)
bullets: la and min both point at the person you apologize to; Amal: same meaning
t2assaftelha = I apologized to her, t2assafli = apologize to me
Command: et2assaf / et2assafi; don't: ma tet2assaf/i

examples.line: Amal: Both mean the same. تنين نفس المعنى - I apologize to you (min or la)
ma 7ada ra7 yet2assaflek - nobody will apologize to you

rules.title: 5ereb = it broke / got ruined by itself, 5arrab = someone ruined it
bullets: 5ereb: the thing itself - shu 5ereb? = what broke?
5arrab (doubled r): a person does it - min 5arrabo? = who ruined it?
kam takes the singular: kam 5u66a 5arrabti? = how many plans have you ruined?
ba5arreb el-denia = I mess everything up (lit. I ruin the world)

examples.line: kam 5u66a 5arrabti? - how many plans have you ruined?
re7letna 5erbat 3ashaan ma66arat - our trip was ruined because it rained
huwwe 3aadatan beysalla7 illi bey5arrbo - he usually fixes what he ruins
ba5arreb el-denia - I mess everything up
